name: agent-dispatch-cutover
description: Tier-P F1 cutover-resilience scenario: install + provision agent-dispatch on a fresh box, then drive the installer-internal `agent-dispatch _cutover` seam (the OS-agnostic zdd active/passive graceful cutover) through a battery of THORNY situations and assert the binding invariant of the correct-install-flows effort (dotfiles#1393) -- a version cutover must NEVER kill in-flight, non-resumable work. Checks: (survive-inflight) a queued task survives the cutover; (held-task-readopt) a claimed+started held task survives and the worker re-adopts the new coordinator via the durable SQLite queue DB; (breadcrumb-recover) an aborted cutover that strands a DRAINED survivor is healed by recovery (undrain); (two-slot-wedged-fd) a wedged daemon holding an open FD in its slot is stood-up-beside and retired, proving the versioned beside-not-in-place model. The heavy orchestration lives in a portable stdlib-only probe so it is verifiable off-Docker too. Name-free / public.
